messages:
sam: Quick question — when we snapshot cost annotations for a canary rollout, can we show the per-token delta + cache-savings breakdown inline? Right now console shows only total delta which hides big wins from KV cache. Screenshot: https://our.fakelink/snap.png :eyes:

julia: Agreed. The totals are misleading for model-switch canaries. We should surface: 1) per-model token-cost 2) cache-saved-tokens 3) amortized cost/unit. Small mock attached in Figma. :point_up:

leo: Two UX notes: a) make cache-savings a separate stacked bar next to token-cost so PMs see savings vs spend, b) let users toggle "per-invocation" vs "per-token" view. :thumbsup:

sid: Also need the telemetry contract. The console currently pulls aggregated metrics at 5m granularity; for per-token deltas we need 1m or per-invocation samples. Can we add a sampled ingest flag instead of full 1m blowup? :thinking_face:

ops-bot: archived snapshot created for canary=canary-2026-03-22T11:33Z by @sam

julia: Proposal: add a new "snapshot_annotations" payload that includes: route, model_variant, tokens_consumed, cache_saved_tokens, latency_p95, cost_estimate. Send at canary snapshot time only. Keeps backend load bounded.

leo: Example telemetry proto we could use (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT route, model_variant, count(*) as invocations,
       sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cache_saved_tokens) as cache_saved,
       sum(tokens*unit_price) as token_cost
FROM invocation_telemetry
WHERE snapshot_ts = :snapshot_ts
GROUP BY route, model_variant
```
This gives us per-model/per-route breakdown without re-ingesting full timeseries.

sam: That looks good. A couple of asks from product: - include baseline_model field so we can auto-calc delta against baseline - mark top-3 diffing reasons (token-length, model-swap, prompt-change) if heuristics detect them.

sid: Baseline is doable if we store reference snapshot id in the rollout object. For heuristics we can compute a simple diff on prompt_shape and token histogram. Adding a small "reasons" array to the snapshot_annotations payload.

julia: UX: show an inline sparklines mini-view comparing baseline vs canary for tokens and cache-savings. Also add an "explain" pill that expands the heuristics reasons.

leo: Implementation concerns: we must ensure snapshot_annotations are signed/immutable for audits (enterprise customers will want that). Also consider retention policy (30d default).

sam: Sounds like consensus. Next steps: 1) sid to draft telemetry proto + sampling strategy 2) eng-platform to add snapshot_annotations endpoint (POST /internal/v1/snapshots) 3) devex to mock UX with stacked token/cache bars 4) security to review immutability/retention. Anyone want to take ownership for the endpoint?

sid: I can take the proto + sampling. Will post a PR with examples. ETA EOW.

julia: I'll schedule a quick UX review Thurs.

leo: I'll stub the console components and wire the toggle.

sam: Awesome — thanks all. If we want to minimize backend churn, prioritize the minimal payload (route/model/tokens/cache/token_cost/baseline_id/reasons). We can add latency/other fields later.

julia: :raised_hands:

leo: Filed follow-up doc in the eng-platform runbook: https://our.fakelink/runbook/snapshot_cost_annotations
